The LinkPower™ LPS940-T1 Outdoor PoE Switch Series offers from 6-Port Gigabit Unmanaged IEEE802.3bt
PoE (Power over Ethernet) Network Switch with 2 Uplink Ports with RJ45 or SFP depending on the models and is
the industry first outdoor weatherproof industrial Gigabit Ethernet switch that delivers data and power over one
single network cable protected with an IP67 compliant weatherproof enclosure. The LPS940-T1 Gigabit PoE
Series has the following six sub-models:
KEY PRODUCT FEATURES
•Three different Gigabit RJ45 ports and SFP fiber port combination, high- •12Gbps Non-blocking switching capacity & 8.93Mpps forwarding
speed high-bandwidth connection to meet different networking needs of rate @ 64 byte
various applications
•1MBit frame buffer memory and 2K entries MAC address table
•Support full-duplex based on IEEE802.3x and half-duplex based on back
pressure •IEEE802.3x flow control for full-duplex mode; back pressure flow
control for half-duplex mode
•4*10/100/1000Base-T RJ45 ports fully support 802.3bt PoE Type 4 high
power requirement in various applications
•Supports integrated address look-up engine, automatic address
learning and address aging
•Maximum PoE power per port is 90W, backward compatible with
IEEE802.3af/at, automatically detect PoE devices to supply power without
•Supports Link Aggregation IEEE 802.3ad and fail over
damaging non-PoE device
•Supports Jumbo Frame in all speeds (up to 9.2K bytes packet
•PoE port priority allows the switch to supply power to the high priority
frame size)
level port first when the power budget is insufficient and avoid overloading
of the device
•Operating Temperature: -22ºF to +158ºF (-30ºC to +70ºC)
